messages:
laura (marketing): quick sync: we need final abstracts + a 30s speaker intro for the webinar landing page. deadline EOD Wed.

sarah (comms): drafting two headline variants: 'Serving LLMs at Scale: Real Cost & Latency Tradeoffs' and a lighter option 'Ship LLM Features Faster: Cost, Latency, and Rollouts' — leaning to the second for broader appeal. thoughts? :thinking_face:

laura (marketing): prefer broader. less infra words. go with second. sarah, can you make 3 short hooks we can A/B in email?

sam (events): rehearsal windows: T-48h full run, T-2h final check, T-15m pre-show. ops roles: producer (sam), host (laura), demo-switch (alex), captions (stream-team), chat-moderator (diego).

nina (speaker-ops): speaker intros: please send 1-line bios + 3 bullets each. will convert to slide per speaker. alex/diego/laura pls DM me yours.

diego (growth): abstract draft: "We show practical tradeoffs when serving LLMs — how routing, caching, and quantization affect latency and unit cost. Includes a short live demo comparing Hosted vs Dedicated setups and an action plan for rollouts." feedback welcome.

laura (marketing): good. simplify first sentence to "We walk through practical tradeoffs when serving LLMs: routing, caching, and quantization." then keep demo note.

alex (eng-demo): demo plan: two short runs (1) hosted baseline (staging key), (2) dedicated pool. show latency percentiles and per-1k-token cost. Pull keys from `staging.redwood-demo`. Use `mock-legal-dataset.csv`. if live demo fails, swap to recorded 2.5m clip.

sam (events): Stream checklist: captions on, stream latency test, record separate files for slides & demo clip. have recorded clip pre-uploaded to StreamY named `demo_hot_swap_v1.mp4`.

laura (marketing): lead routing: add two checkboxes on registration form: "Interested in Dedicated" and "Enterprise contact". route to HubSpot lists: hs-list-dedicated and hs-list-enterprise. hubspot-bot, confirm webhook name?

hubspot-bot: Webhook configured: `hs-webinar-llm-prod-2026`. Test payload will be delivered to /webhooks/marketing during staging test.

laura (marketing): also add UTM params for tweet/live social: `utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=llm_tradeoffs_may2026`. sarah, will that break our short links?

sarah (comms): no problem. we'll ensure short links use our tracker and include UTM. will prep 3 live social lines per speaker.

nina (speaker-ops): rehearsal run-of-show (short):
```
00:00-02:00  Host welcome + title slide (laura)
02:00-07:00  Product demo (alex) - hosted vs dedicated
07:00-13:00  Benchmarks & rollout playbook (diego)
13:00-18:00  Getting started & CTA (laura)
18:00-25:00  Live Q&A (panel)
25:00-30:00  Close + post-webinar CTAs (laura)
```

laura (marketing): add 2min buffer between demo and diego to handle any transition. nina, update times accordingly.

nina (speaker-ops): done. also: mic policy—mute until cued, wired headphones preferred, have a backup laptop ready. backstage comms via this Slack thread only.

diego (growth): slide asks: one cost summary slide (simple chart), one latency P95 vs P50, one rollout checklist. i'll prepare a 1-line explainer for each slide so laura can read non-tech copy.

alex (eng-demo): devops: can infra add rate limits to staging key and a temp allowlist for presenters' IPs? need this by T-48h.

laura (marketing): tagging infra in DM. also: legal note—no customer data in demo. confirm mock dataset cleansed.

sam (events): final tech test schedule: T-48h 11:00am PT full run (all speakers), T-2h 3:00pm PT final check (only host + producer + demo-switch), T-15m pre-show mic check.

sarah (comms): social plan: live tweet during demo start, RT attendee questions, post short clip of demo with CTA to trial, schedule follow-up email to attendees + registrants with recording.

laura (marketing): analytics: track registration -> attended -> demo interest click. diego, can you own the HubSpot list segmentation & follow-up sequence?

diego (growth): yep, will create hs-list-dedicated segmentation + follow-up workflow (email + SDR ping).

laura (marketing): last minute: who will test the HubSpot webhook during the full run? sam please.

sam (events): i'll run the test during T-48h full run. will confirm webhook delivered and lists populated.

laura (marketing): thanks team. small asks by EOD Wed: abstracts + bios (speakers), demo clip (alex), slides (diego), social drafts (sarah), webhook test (sam). we'll reconfirm in T-48h run thread. :rocket:
